plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System MVP Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with users, patients, doctors, availability_slots, appointments, and notifications tables
Implement backend REST API with Node.js/Express/TypeScript for user authentication and patient registration (F1)
Build doctor schedule management API endpoints for setting availability and viewing appointments (F3)
Create appointment booking API with slot availability checking and conflict prevention (F2)
Develop React frontend components for Patient Home Dashboard, Doctor Selection & Booking, and Appointment Details screens
Implement appointment cancellation and rescheduling functionality in backend and frontend (F4)
Build My Appointments List screen with filtering by status (upcoming/past/cancelled) and search capability
Create Patient Profile & Settings screen with editable personal information and preferences
Develop Doctor Schedule Management screen for viewing daily appointments and managing availability
Implement email and SMS notification system for appointment confirmations and 24-hour reminders (F5)
Add database indexes on frequently queried columns (email, role, doctor_id, appointment_date, status) for performance optimization
Integrate frontend with backend APIs and implement error handling and loading states
Conduct end-to-end testing of core user flows: registration, booking, rescheduling, and cancellation
Deploy MVP to staging environment and perform user acceptance testing with sample data

risks: Slot booking conflicts if concurrent users attempt to book the same time slot simultaneously without proper transaction handling
Email/SMS notification delivery failures or delays could result in missed appointments and poor user experience
Database performance degradation with large appointment volumes if indexes are not properly configured
Mobile responsiveness issues if components are not thoroughly tested across different device sizes and platforms
Security vulnerabilities in authentication system if password hashing and session management are not implemented correctly
